scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.install:ci: npm ci --include=dev && npm ci --prefix server --include=dev && npm ci --prefix client --include=dev
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build:deploy
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix client run typecheck
scripts.phone: concurrently -k -n server,client,tunnel -c magenta,cyan,yellow "npm:dev:server" "npm --prefix client run phone" "cloudflared tunnel --url http://localhost:4173"
